dog.description_text: At 15 years old and just 12 pounds, Lilo might surprise you. Her foster mom went out for groceries and came home to a little dog hopping with excitement at the door. Turns out one of the sweetest things about adopting a senior dog is how quickly they can make even a Tuesday grocery run feel like a homecoming. Lilo walks nicely on leash, has been accident-free in foster, and settles into her crate at night. She loves sitting close to her people and would be happy to keep you company through the quiet parts of your day. Lilo is receiving veterinary care, and our team is happy to talk through her ongoing needs with anyone interested in welcoming her home. Lilo is under veterinary care after a respiratory illness affected her appetite. She’s eating again with support from her vet, and she’ll need follow-up for abnormal bloodwork, significant dental disease, and a growth in one ear. Lilo is exempt from apay surgery at her age, and we're waiting on her bloodtest results for next stpes.
dog.name: Lilo
